$$

The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic secant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arsech}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{\sqrt{x-{x}^{3}}-1}{2x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{\sqrt{x-{x}^{3}}}{2x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}\,\text{d}x-\int \frac{1}{2x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int \frac{\sqrt{x}\cdot \sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}{2x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}\,\text{d}x-\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{1}{x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\,\text{d}x+\frac{1}{2}\int -\frac{1}{x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\sqrt{x}+\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{arsech}⁡x+C.\end{aligned}
$$
